blocks.title: Access modifiers
blocks.text: Access modifiers set who can reach a class's attributes and methods. Python marks them by naming: public (no underscore), protected (one underscore) and private (two underscores).

blocks.caption: Access modifiers in Python
rows: only inside the class; use a method such as get_color()

blocks.title: Python code (each .... is one 4-space indent)
blocks.text:
class Car:
....def __init__(self, color):
........self.__color = color    # private

....def get_color(self):
........return self.__color
